subject: Post-call: Platform fit & proposed integration / PoC plan
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@healthlytics.co>, Amy Chen <amy.chen@healthlytics.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed PoC scope (platform fit & integration)

Hi Luis / Amy —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a proposed next-step PoC so we can validate fit on your highest-priority jobs.

Key pain points you shared:
- Latency and throughput: need sub-120ms p95 for conversational assistant flows when under 50 concurrent users; peak bursts up to ~100 req/s for nightly triage jobs.
- Integration friction: current vendor SDKs are heavyweight; your eng team wants simple function-calling hooks and event streaming for partial responses.
- Ranking accuracy: you run a multi-stage retrieval + rerank pipeline; higher-quality embeddings and a lightweight reranker would let you reduce expensive re-runs.
- Observability / audits: must capture per-request tracing and retention for 90 days for compliance.

What we believe Redwood can deliver for a short PoC (4 weeks):
- Integration: lightweight SDK patch (1-2 files) with examples for function-calling and streaming partial tokens into your front-end.
- Performance validation: stress tests to target p95 <120ms on rw-open-7b-quant with batching and prefix-KV caching; show cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Retrieval + rerank: run an A/B on your sample dataset (top-100 retrievals) comparing your current embeddings -> rerank vs Redwood embeddings + our reranker; measure MRR / recall lift.
- Observability: wire up tracing + token-level cost breakdown in Console; provide initial audit logs export.

Proposed deliverables and timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): hand off test credentials, sample dataset (100 queries + references), and access to a dev environment.
- Week 1: SDK integration + function-calling demo; streaming example for partial responses.
- Week 2: Performance tuning (batching, quantization), baseline latency tests.
- Week 3: Rerank A/B and quality report.
- Week 4: Executive summary, cost/ops recommendations, and go/no-go decision for a broader pilot.

Immediate asks from you to start:
1) Share a small sample dataset (100 queries) and 5 representative prompts for the assistant flows.
2) Confirm a technical contact for access (can be dev or infra) and a windows for a 30–45 min technical deep dive next week.
3) Any procurement constraints (MFA, PO process, SOC2 evidence) we should prep early.

I attached a one-page PoC scope and a short SDK notes file with example endpoints. If you prefer, we can shorten the PoC to a two-week technical spike focusing only on latency + streaming.

Thanks — I’ll slot a technical deep dive with Karthik if you confirm an available time.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_poc_scope_v1.pdf (1 page)
Attachment: redwood_sdk_integration_notes.txt (code snippets)
From: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@healthlytics.co>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amy Chen <amy.chen@healthlytics.co>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed PoC scope (platform fit & integration)

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear summary — this captures our priorities well. A couple quick clarifications: 
- The 120ms p95 is for the UI assistant flows (single-turn) — for the nightly batch triage jobs the throughput requirement matters more than tight p95.
- For the reranker A/B test, we can provide labeled data (50 queries with expected top-5) and a sandbox index.
- Procurement: we can start with a standard MSFT SOW + your SOC2/ISO artifacts; procurement lead is Amy (copied).

We can commit to providing the sample dataset and a dev account this week. Technical contact will be Rajiv Kumar (rajiv.kumar@healthlytics.co) — please include him on the technical deep dive.

For timeline, a condensed two-week spike focused on SDK + latency would be ideal to surface regressions quickly. If results look good, we’ll expand into the rerank quality work.

Available slots for the deep dive next week: Thu 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 13:00–14:00 PT. Pick one and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Cheers,
Luis
Head of Product
HealthLytics
